title: Panache
description: If you play 5 cards this turn, deal damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: If you play {CardsLeft} more {CardsLeft:plural:card|cards} this turn, deal {Amount} damage to ALL enemies.
notes: Counter starts at 5 and decrements as cards are played each turn. When the counter reaches 0, damage is dealt to all enemies and the counter resets. The Panache card itself is not counted toward the total (tracked via the alreadyApplied flag).
